description.value:
The yagudos are a race of crow-like bipeds inhabiting the continent of Mindartia, violently devout and ritualistic, organized under a strict religious hierarchy.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Yagudos gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.
  • Size: Yagudos are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Yagudos are Humanoid creatures with the yagudo subtype.
  • Base Speed: Yagudos have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Yagudos begin play speaking Common and their own dialect of Yagudo. Yagudos with high Intelligence scores can choose any language as a bonus language.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Feathers of Gale: Yagudos gain a +1 natural armor bonus.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Stalker: Perception and Stealth are always class skills for yagudo.
  • Valiant Linguist: Yagudos gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics.
  • Zealot Devotee: Yagudos gain a +2 to all Knowledge (Religion) checks and an additional +1 per 5 ranks in the skill.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Biting Is the Last Resort: Yagudos possess a bite natural attack dealing 1d4 points of damage.
  • Swordtrained: Yagudo are automatically proficient with swordlike weapons (scizores, cutlasses, daggers, falchions, greatswords, kukris, longswords, punching daggers, rapiers, scimitars, short swords, and sword canes).

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: A yagudo can see twice as far as a hume in dim light.
